name: Camping Sebastian Huber
beschreibung: The campsite Camping Sebastian Huber is located in the peaceful village of Söchtenau. It offers a close-to-nature atmosphere ideal for holidaymakers seeking rest in the alpine foothills. The grounds provide parcelled pitches for motorhomes and tents, accompanied by sanitary facilities and electrical hookups. In the surrounding countryside, hiking paths and cycle trails invite exploration towards the nearby Inntal valley.
